name: dgVoodoo2
summary: A DirectX and Glide API wrapper that translates DX1–DX9 and 3dfx Glide calls into DirectX 11 or 12. Used as a prerequisite for Geo-11 fixes on older DX9 games, since Geo-11 requires a DX11 surface to intercept. Drop-in: copy the DLLs into the game folder alongside the Geo-11 fix.
compatibility_notes: Not all DX9 games require this — some DX9 games work with Geo-11 directly. Required when Geo-11 cannot hook the game's renderer. May introduce minor visual differences on some titles (texture filtering, resolution handling). Still actively developed.
